W.note: Axis-aligned boxes at 240 Hz stack cleanly with throws and a full add/reset/clear set plus a visible hint, though boxes never rotate and floor friction is crude.

X.note: Rigid rotating bodies with SAT contacts, sleeping and a spring grab give the most believable stacking and tumbling, but there is no on-screen hint and only a Reset control.

Y.note: Direct kinematic drag with clean throws and a tidy floor that stays stable, but the boxes are axis-aligned and the only control is Reset with no instructions.

Z.note: Good controls and HUD instructions and a direct drag, but a neighbouring box was launched off the stack during a drag and one box looks unsupported in the desktop rest frame, and the HUD covers the stack on phone.
